lifecycleRules.stable: Root export, co-located story, focused test, generated catalog documentation, and stable catalog status are all present.
lifecycleRules.preview: The component is public and documented but is missing at least one stable evidence item.
lifecycleRules.internal-review: The source directory is not exported from the package root or is absent from the public generated catalog.
lifecycleRules.note: Authored MDX and recipe CSS are reported but do not gate stability because generated references and intentionally unstyled components are supported.

lifecycleReasons: not exported from the package root
not present in the generated component catalog
